# TailNG

> Agent-oriented documentation for installing, configuring, and using TailNG in Angular applications.

Use the package versions and compatibility data from https://tailng.dev/ai/versions.json before changing an application.

## Start here

- [TailNG agent guide](https://tailng.dev/ai/index.md): Entry point for installing, configuring, and using TailNG in Angular applications.
- [TailNG installation](https://tailng.dev/ai/installation/index.md): Choose and verify the correct TailNG installation path for an Angular application.
- [TailNG configuration](https://tailng.dev/ai/configuration/index.md): Configure TailNG providers, global styles, and styling strategy in Angular.
- [TailNG components](https://tailng.dev/ai/components/index.md): Discover the documented TailNG styled components and their Angular imports.
- [TailNG theme](https://tailng.dev/ai/theme/index.md): Configure TailNG presets, runtime theme application, tokens, and component contracts.
- [TailNG icons](https://tailng.dev/ai/icons/index.md): Configure and use TailNG icons with the built-in Lucide pack or explicit custom packs.
- [TailNG troubleshooting](https://tailng.dev/ai/troubleshooting/index.md): Diagnose package, provider, component import, icon, and stylesheet failures.
- [AI Chat foundation overview](https://tailng.dev/ai/components/ai-chat/overview.md): Render a professional protocol-neutral AI chat with canonical messages, custom Angular parts, bounded history, and AG-UI 1.0 events.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [Package versions](https://tailng.dev/ai/versions.json)
